name: hyper-v-control
description: Control Hyper-V VMs, graphical consoles, guest automation and user/kernel debugging through a native C# stdio MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: VM lifecycle, computer use, and Windows debugging.
interface.longDescription: A compiled Windows x64 C# MCP server over stdio. Manage VM lifecycle and checkpoints, operate Basic and Enhanced consoles, transfer files, automate guest UI with winapp, and debug user processes or a guest kernel with current WinDbg engines.
defaultPrompt: Use Hyper-V Control to inspect my VMs and choose the right management, automation, or debugging workflow.
